narrative.overview: EcoMiles pairs the crisp legibility of a modern financial ledger with the spatial clarity of an urban cartographic atlas. Designed for logistics dispatchers working under bright warehouse/office lighting and enterprise executives evaluating Scope 3 carbon compliance, the interface favors daylight paper surfaces, decisive forest-emerald actions, and live operational proof over dark decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight-first surfaces (#f8fafc alabaster ground with #ffffff crisp paper containers)
Visual-first product proof replacing verbose paragraphs
Tabular numeric discipline (tabular-nums) across every km, kg, VND, and CO2e reading

rules.name: The Anti-Gym Rule
rules.body: Never pair a near-black page background with neon lime/red bordered membership boxes on marketing or pricing surfaces; B2B logistics trust lives on crisp daylight paper.

rules.name: The Zero-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Never place an uppercase pill or eyebrow kicker above h1 or h2 headings; let the heading carry its own hierarchy.

rules.name: The Monospace Restraint Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only for genuine identifiers (license plates, SHA-256/KMS hashes, numeric cells), never as a tech costume on marketing copy.

dos: Do keep public landing copy concise and pair every claim with a real product visual or interactive control.
Do enforce font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every numeric KPI, table column, timer, and price.
Do require explicit Đăng xuất before switching between B2B company tenants.
donts: Don't use dark gym-card pricing blocks, neon yellow full-bleed fills, or gradient text.
Don't place eyebrow kickers above section headings or use thick border-l-4 stripes.
Don't expose developer acronyms (JSON, Bearer DEMO, raw code tags) on public marketing sections.
